chunks: They looked at them with weak-sighted eyes, and descended from them into

the hollow of ignorance. If they had asked the dilapidated houses and empty courtyards about them, they would have said: 'They went into the earth in misguidance, and you followed in their footsteps in ignorance. You trample their skulls, build upon their corpses, graze on what they left, and dwell in what they vacated. And indeed, the days between you and them are weeping and reciting elegies over you.'

key_terms.عَرَصَات: open spaces or courtyards of houses

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the hypocrites' houses and lands in Quran 9:102 according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali employs vivid personification, portraying the empty dwellings and ruins of the hypocrites as silent witnesses testifying to their misguidance and the believers' subsequent ignorance. This imagery underscores the transient nature of worldly possessions inherited by those who 'tread upon their heels,' linking material inheritance with spiritual negligence. The passage serves as a poignant reminder that the physical remnants of the Munafiqun are not merely property but evidence of their failed legacy.

en.sayed-ali-raza: They looked at them with weak-sighted eyes and descended into the hollow of ignorance.

If they had asked about them from the dilapidated houses and empty courtyards, they would have said that they went into the earth in the state of misguidance and you too are heading ignorantly towards them. You trample their skulls, want to raise constructions on their corpses, you graze what they have left and live in houses which they have vacated. The days (that lie) between them and you are also bemoaning you and reciting elegies over you.
